images.alt: Announcement square graphic with a light grey background and a dark blue bell icon at the top. Bold heading reads ‘ANNOUNCEMENT’. Below, smaller text states: ‘Alcohol levy confirmed to support harm reduction across communities.’ At the bottom are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo.

post.text:
The alcohol levy has been updated for 2026/27 to maintain funding for services that reduce alcohol-related harm across New Zealand. 

The levy will be set at $17.135 million, a modest increase to maintain its real value and support continuation of existing programmes.
